current_budget_model.max_tokens: one shared per-attempt provider completion cap
current_budget_model.reasoning_counts_against_same_cap: confirmed for the exact Boundary 12 fallback observation
current_budget_model.primary_fallback_request_shape: same application fields and corresponding attempt budgets
current_budget_model.budget_expansion: doubles or adds 1024 within existing recovery policy but does not partition reasoning from final output

provider_capability_decision.reason: The sealed probe observed response shape only. It did not send or qualify a reasoning-control parameter, and an Anthropic-compatible protocol name does not prove endpoint-specific support.
provider_capability_decision.required_before_enablement: a route-fingerprint-bound capability qualification proving the exact parameter is accepted and enforced

selected_design.name: FINAL_ARTIFACT_RESERVATION_WITH_CAPABILITY_GUARD_V1
selected_design.why_selected: It is the smallest mechanism-level design that can guarantee safety without changing prompt, model identity, route configuration, retry count or total output-token ceiling.

invariants: T equals the existing per-attempt max_output_tokens and is never increased by this policy
F is derived deterministically from the existing expected_output_characters plus the registered artifact schema/topology, never from Provider output
0 < F < T for a reasoning-enabled eligible route
the Provider receives T as the total cap and a verified explicit reasoning cap no greater than R
a route with unknown, stale, unsupported or violated allocation capability is ineligible before another paid dispatch
allocation_contract.guarantee_boundary: The guarantee is conditional on a current route-bound proof that the Provider enforces the reasoning cap. If that proof is absent, the safe behavior is typed pre-dispatch ineligibility, not an unreserved call.
allocation_contract.non_guarantee: Reservation guarantees space cannot be consumed by reasoning; it does not guarantee the model will emit a valid or semantically correct artifact. Existing conversion and domain validators remain authoritative.

reserve_sizing.rule: Introduce a versioned deterministic final-artifact reserve calculator. It must preserve the caller's planning_semantic_v2 expected-output estimate; minimum_business_characters=160 is only a business-incompleteness floor and is not sufficient as the reservation value.
reserve_sizing.calibration_requirement: Calibrate and freeze the planning_semantic_v2 whole, segment and nested-packet reserve using sanitized valid artifacts and invariant-based tests before production enablement.
forbidden: using Provider name/model name as a branch
deriving F from the Boundary 12 observed number alone

exact_implementation_owners.responsibility: carry a typed provider-independent output-allocation request; no free-form provider parameters
bind contract identity, expected final size, T/F/R and route attempt; preserve existing retry schedule
enforce current route capability, refuse unknown allocation, and pass the typed allocation to the adapter
make reasoning-allocation capability route-fingerprint-bound, expiring and stale-safe
serialize only a verified typed reasoning cap and retain max_tokens=T; never invent endpoint support

smallest_modification_location_answer: The policy owner is the shared contract-to-provider allocation boundary, not workflows.py and not the planning prompt. context_policy computes the reserve; ModelGateway is the enforcement point; the protocol adapter is only the wire encoder.

behavior_impacts.primary_route: unchanged when its current capability proves reasoning does not consume the final cap or proves reservation enforcement; otherwise it becomes typed ineligible for reservation-required calls
behavior_impacts.configured_fallback: the observed route must be freshly qualified; if it supports enforcement it keeps the same identity with one bounded parameter, otherwise it cannot safely serve this contract
behavior_impacts.retry: attempt counts, ordering and resume behavior unchanged; no continuation call and no extra retry
behavior_impacts.route_configuration: unchanged by the recommended patch; replacing an incapable route is a separate decision
behavior_impacts.cost: per-call maximum and total call budget do not increase; realized output cost may fall, but this is not claimed without evidence
behavior_impacts.latency: no additional call is introduced; successful earlier final emission may reduce latency, while capability refusal may stop earlier

failure_and_recovery_semantics.capability_unknown_or_stale: typed pre-dispatch route ineligibility with zero Provider call
failure_and_recovery_semantics.capability_explicitly_unsupported: typed pre-dispatch route ineligibility; route replacement requires separate authorization
failure_and_recovery_semantics.provider_rejects_parameter: quarantine the route-fingerprint capability and return a typed capability failure; do not retry with the parameter removed
failure_and_recovery_semantics.provider_violates_qualified_cap: quarantine the capability and retain the last accepted authority; do not increase tokens or guess
failure_and_recovery_semantics.final_artifact_invalid_with_reservation: use the unchanged canonical conversion, semantic validation and existing bounded recovery schedule
failure_and_recovery_semantics.terminal: preserve existing ContractOutputLimitExhaustedError/capability exhaustion distinctions and accepted checkpoints

invariants_preserved: no raw Prompt, story or Provider content in capability receipts
